# The swarm never runs more agents than the slots of the config, and it uses both slots when there is work for both.
# The config has two logins and the backlog holds four tasks. The fake agents meet at a rendezvous (the file rendezvous), so the two overlap by construction and a third slot would show as the count 3.
isolate
swarmfakes

exec obeeswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
exec obeeswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star

# All four tasks ran and landed.
grep -count=4 '^task ' calls.log
grep -count=4 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log

# Two agents ran at once, and never three.
grep '^2$' concurrency.log
! grep '^[3-9]$' concurrency.log

-- rendezvous --
-- backlog.txt --
P1	one	a.txt
P1	two	b.txt
P1	three	c.txt
P1	four	d.txt
